compatibility: additive 150-character naming semantic core, source-bound pronunciation mapping, and official name-trend source registry

conventions.source_reference: Prefer source_id values registered in data/meta/sources.csv for new structured datasets.
conventions.method_reference: Use method_id for school- or author-dependent naming and myeongri rules.
conventions.legal_hanja: Candidate search data and final legal verification are separate layers.
conventions.stroke_counts: Unicode technical strokes and naming-school stroke counts are separate fields.
conventions.null_policy: Unknown values remain null/empty; do not infer unsupported facts.
conventions.surname_role: Treat surname Hanja, given-name Hanja, bongwan, census statistics, and method-specific stroke values as separate fields.
conventions.surname_semantics: Do not score a surname dictionary gloss as given-name semantic quality unless a selected method explicitly requires it.
conventions.surname_pronunciation: Store phonological structure separately from subjective euphony; do not treat repetition notices as hard failures.
conventions.clan_history: Store clan-history claims with evidence_level and caveat; census identity and genealogical tradition are separate.
conventions.surname_strokes: A dictionary/technical stroke count is not a default numerology count; method_id is required for naming-school calculations.
conventions.common_surname_coverage: Core surname data covers 2015 census ranks 1-31; top30-excluding-xu-2015.csv records the 30 newly added surnames because 徐(rank 13) was already present.
conventions.representative_clans: representative-clans-2015.csv is partial and must never be interpreted as a complete clan list.
conventions.hangul_hanja_disambiguation: Same Hangul surname with different Hanja must remain separate surname_id records.
conventions.genealogy_claim_roles: Keep founder, progenitor, middle ancestor, branch founder, historical clan reference, genealogy documentation, myth and legend as distinct claim types.
conventions.genealogy_conflicts: Never auto-resolve conflicting founder or origin claims; preserve source_ids, evidence_level and caveat.
conventions.hangnyeol: Do not infer or generate generation names unless a verified clan-specific source is registered.
conventions.clan_summary: Use up to seven major bongwan rows plus a computed remainder that closes exactly to the surname total; never label the computed remainder as the source table's 기타.
conventions.full_clan_raw: KOSIS DT_1IN15SD all-5plus bongwan raw coverage is distinct from the app summary layer.
conventions.hanja_meaning_key: Use (hanja, legal_reading) as the semantic lookup key; do not merge meanings across readings.
conventions.hanja_meaning_layers: Keep source meaning string, split senses, selected naming sense, and natural-language naming interpretation as separate layers.
conventions.hanja_meaning_noninvent: Do not invent auspicious meanings not supported by a registered sense source.
conventions.hanja_meaning_other_senses: Selecting one naming sense does not erase other documented senses; keep them available to users.
conventions.naming_interpretation: Interpretation templates are editorial paraphrases, not dictionary definitions.
conventions.selected_sense: Store selected_sense_ids separately from all documented sense IDs; selection does not alter dictionary senses.
conventions.selection_origin: Record whether the intended sense came from user/parent declaration, editorial suggestion, historical record, or is unknown.
conventions.semantic_risk: Semantic risk is an explanatory notice level, not auspiciousness and not automatic rejection; invalid is reserved for unsupported sense or reading mismatch.
conventions.unknown_naming_intent: Do not invent a parent's original naming intention for an existing name when it is unknown.
conventions.generated_data: Derived files with an exact generator are registered in data/meta/build-manifest.json and checked by CI.
conventions.quality_gates: App and AI must check data/meta/quality-gates.json before presenting incomplete layers as authoritative.
conventions.json_schema: Files named *.schema.json use JSON Schema draft 2020-12; explanatory policy is stored separately.
conventions.official_hanja_diff: Current legal Hanja full coverage is not claimed until normalized official reading-character rows are diffed against the mirror.
conventions.method_registry: Traditional naming calculations require a registered method_id and must not be merged into a universal score.
conventions.semantic_source_hold: Suspicious or malformed source senses are held for recheck and must not be silently corrected or promoted to naming meanings.
conventions.legal_rule_layer: Current legal naming rules are stored separately from candidate Hanja mirrors and traditional naming interpretations.
conventions.saju_boundary_vectors: Solar-term month-branch changes are regression-tested at one minute before and exactly at verified boundaries.
conventions.reference_implementation_time_basis: Record timezone/clock basis for external calendar implementations; never compare raw clock fields across KST/CST as if they were the same instant.
conventions.saju_crosscheck_not_golden: Independent implementation output is crosscheck evidence, not a Korean golden vector, unless timezone and method assumptions are independently verified.
conventions.pronunciation_mapping: Pronunciation-five-elements mappings are method-specific tables; unsupported onsets remain unsupported rather than silently normalized.
conventions.trend_data: Birth-name and rename-name statistics are separate datasets; popularity is not auspiciousness and requires period/sex/source metadata.
